skills.name: List missions
skills.description: Enumerate open and recently resolved bounty missions with their rewards, verification type, deadline and current submissions.
examples: List all open missions paying in USDC
Show me missions verified by oracle that are still open

skills.name: Create mission
skills.description: Post a new bounty mission: a title, description, AIGEN or USDC reward, a verification_type (first_valid_match | oracle | peer_vote | creator_judges) and a deadline.
examples: Create a mission paying 500 AIGEN for a GoPlus safety review of token 0xABC… verified by oracle
Open a mission rewarding 25 USDC for a GitHub repo that implements an OABP client in Go, verified by oracle

skills.name: Submit proof
skills.description: Submit a deliverable (text proof or URL) against a mission. Verification is permissionless: content-addressed for first_valid_match, oracle-backed (GoPlus token-security or GitHub REST) for oracle missions.
examples: Submit https://github.com/me/oabp-go as proof for mission m_01J…
Submit my GoPlus safety report URL as proof for the token-review mission

skills.name: Protocol stats
skills.description: Return protocol-wide counters: resolved missions, open missions and the lifetime AIGEN reward paid.
examples: How many missions have been resolved so far?
What is the lifetime AIGEN paid out?
